```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">
  <!-- Dimensions (meters) -->
  <!-- Chest footprint: width (X) = 0.55, depth (Y) = 0.23 -->
  <!-- Chest height (body): = 0.53, lid thickness assumed: = 0.03 -->
  <!-- Coordinate frame: origin on floor under middle of object -->
  <!-- X: across width, Y: toward back (front faces -Y), Z up -->

  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate box inertia: Ixx=(1/12)m*(d^2+h^2), Iyy=(1/12)m*(w^2+h^2), Izz=(1/12)m*(w^2+d^2) -->
      <!-- w=0.55 (X), d=0.23 (Y), h=0.53 (Z) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.7166667" iyy="0.9708333" izz="1.6154167" effort="0" velocity="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.53"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.53"/>
      </geometry>
    </visual>
  </link>

  <link name="lid">
    <!-- Lid mass/inertia based on a thin box:
         lid size: width 0.55 (X), depth 0.23 (Y), thickness 0.03 (Z)
         hinge along back edge: at Y=+0.115, lid swings about +X axis -->
    <inertial>
      <!-- Lid centered at mid-depth in Y and thickness centered in Z.
           At home (closed) pose, lid top aligns with overall height 0.53:
           Base top at z=0.53. Lid thickness 0.03 => lid center at z=0.53 + 0.015 -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.5"/>
      <!-- Approx box inertia: w=0.55, d=0.23, h=0.03 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.043125" iyy="0.3241667" izz="0.273125" effort="0" velocity="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.55 0.23 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
    </visual>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinge joint: lid rotates about X at back edge.
       Joint origin at hinge line: x=0, y=+0.115, z=0.53 (top of base / bottom of lid in closed pose)
       Lid link frame is oriented so that:
         - at joint angle 0, lid is horizontal (closed)
         - lid rotates upward about the X axis with positive direction opening toward +Z.
  -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <origin xyz="0 0.115 0.53" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0" upper="1.57079632679" effort="50" velocity="2"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.05"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Optional: keep lid from intersecting by adding a second collision proxy around hinge region (still real geometry).
       Not required by spec; omitted. -->
</robot>
```
